OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF TRANSPORTATION WASHINGTON, D.C. 20590
December 4, 1974
Deputy Assistant Director National and International Programs National Science Foundation 1800 G Street, N.W., Rm. 703 Washington, D.C. 20550
Dear Sir:
In response to Mr. T. O. Jones' request of October 29, 1974, we are enclosing comments on the draft environmental impact statement on the Ross Ice Shelf Project. We secured these comments from the Coast Guard based on their extensive background in the subject area. We concur with their conclusions and observations.
Sincerely,
Mantin Convisser Direct
Martin Convisser, Director Office of Environmental Affairs Office of Environment, Safety, and Consumer Affairs
Enclosure
